Name: highRollerSlots
Author: Tomokisan1
Description:
Add more bet options in slots machines.

The missing assets was created for English (default) and French.

Feel free to create the assets corresponding to your own language, the mod support it natively you just have to name them with same name pattern as the French ones included.

Compatible with : [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1089]Fast Animations[/url]
